# Repomix parser fixtures

These fixtures are **synthetic** exports generated by the real Repomix CLI. They contain no
real repository code. They exist to keep parser fidelity tests reproducible without requiring
Node.js at test time.

- Generator: `repomix@1.19.0`
- Generated: 2026-11-19
- Source tree: [`sample/`](sample/) for the main fixtures; a small edge-case tree constructed by
  [`generate.sh`](generate.sh) for `repomix-1.19.0/edge/`.
- Line endings and BOMs are preserved by [`.gitattributes`](.gitattributes) (`* -text`).

## Layout

| Path | Repomix invocation |
|---|---|
| `repomix-1.19.0/markdown/repomix-output.md` | `--style markdown` |
| `repomix-1.19.0/markdown-parsable/repomix-output.md` | `--style markdown --parsable-style` |
| `repomix-1.19.0/xml/repomix-output.xml` | `--style xml` |
| `repomix-1.19.0/xml-parsable/repomix-output.xml` | `--style xml --parsable-style` |
| `repomix-1.19.0/json/repomix-output.json` | `--style json` |
| `repomix-1.19.0/line-numbers/*` | `--output-show-line-numbers` (expected to be rejected) |
| `repomix-1.19.0/edge/*` | Fence-length, trailing-space, and XML-special-character cases |

All invocations also use `--no-git-sort-by-changes` for deterministic ordering.

## Regenerating

```bash
bash tests/fixtures/generate.sh
```

The script requires Node.js and downloads `repomix@1.19.0` through `npx`. Do not regenerate
fixtures with a different Repomix version without updating this file, the directory name, and
the compatibility notes in `docs/PARSER_COMPATIBILITY.md`.

## Known lossy behavior in these fixtures

Repomix itself strips each file's UTF-8 BOM and final newline, and excludes binary files. The
reconstructor cannot restore those. `sample/src/bom.txt`, `sample/src/no-newline.txt`, and
`sample/src/crlf.txt` demonstrate the exact content Repomix emits.
